description:
Search the official documentation of Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex and MCP. Use it before answering any question about using, configuring or administering these products. Not for other products or general programming. If the answer could differ between products and the user hasn't said which one, ask.

Returns one passage per page, with the page's one-line description and a
relevance score; under ~0.5 means the docs probably don't cover it. One
topic per call: split multi-part questions. Need more than the passage?
Call read_section(url), or read_section(url, heading) for one of the
passage's other_sections.

product.description: Only this product. Set it when the user has named the product, now or earlier in the conversation. Otherwise leave it empty: an unfiltered search still finds product-specific pages, while a wrong product hides the right ones.
product.title: Product

query.description: What to find, in English: keywords or a short question, e.g. "<product> <feature> <what you need>".
query.title: Query

response_format.description: `concise` (default): first 300 characters of each passage, enough to choose. `detailed`: full passages, about 800 tokens each. Start concise; re-run detailed with a small limit for the pages you need.
response_format.title: Response Format

name: search_docs

description.description: One sentence on what the page is; empty if unavailable.
description.title: Description

other_sections.description: Other sections of this page that also match, best first; pass one to read_section as `heading`. Empty when none does.
other_sections.title: Other Sections

score.description: Cohere rerank relevance in [0, 1]. Low scores across all passages mean the docs may not cover the query; consider rephrasing.
score.title: Score

truncated.description: True when `content` was trimmed; re-run detailed for the rest.
truncated.title: Truncated

url.description: Source URL; pass it to read_section.
url.title: Url

index_snapshot.description: Date the documentation was indexed (ISO); null if unknown.
index_snapshot.title: Index Snapshot

passages.description: Ranked documentation passages. Empty if nothing matched.
passages.title: Passages

title: Search official agent docs
